narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Half of thirty is fifteen, so it was half covered on day fifteen.
<bookmark mark='tiny'/>On day fifteen the pond is still almost empty, with only a small patch of lotuses.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The lotuses double each day, they do not grow by the same amount.
